stem: Which clinical sign is characteristic of psoriatic arthritis in childhood?
explanation: Dactylitis, or the swelling of an entire digit due to tendon and joint inflammation, is a well-recognized feature of psoriatic arthritis.
rationale: This term refers to the 'sausage digit' appearance.

optionExplanations.A: Dactylitis, or the swelling of an entire digit due to tendon and joint inflammation, is a well-recognized feature of psoriatic arthritis.
optionExplanations.B: Muscle weakness is more typical of myositis than the joint-focused symptoms of psoriatic arthritis.
optionExplanations.C: Fever spikes are the hallmark of systemic JIA, not the psoriatic subtype.
optionExplanations.D: While spinal involvement can occur in spondyloarthropathies, cervical fusion is highlighted more in the context of polyarticular JIA.

source.hint: This term refers to the 'sausage digit' appearance.
